name: splice-eligibility-guard
body: The win-C eligibility decision and its seed-equivalence guard: `rust.apg.pipeline.try_splice_build` decides splice vs full load; `rust.apg.splice.seed.seed_checked`, `rust.apg.splice.seed.seed_key_matches` and `rust.apg.splice.seed.recorded_content_key` are the content-identity equivalence check, and `rust.apg.splice.seed.seed` performs the whole-file seed. The guard folds the assembled graph's durable-layer/transient rows into a digest through `rust.apg.splice.seed.assembled_authored_identity`, folds the seed DB's matching rows through `rust.apg.splice.seed.seed_authored_identity`, admits the splice when the two digests compare equal, and reports a difference as `rust.apg.splice.seed.SeedFallback::UnrepresentedAuthored` with a full load.
